exact.Operationele reserve voor de nacht/ochte: Operational reserve for the night and morning. Normal self-consumption and Battery Save will not discharge below this limit. Charge planning targets at least this SoC; Peak Guard may still use the reserve down to Minimum SoC when needed.
exact.In Batterij sparen mag elke batterij afz: In Battery Save, each battery may discharge while its SoC is above this threshold. 100% means fully save the battery. Peak Guard may always intervene down to Minimum SoC, but never below it.
exact.Als de volledige PV-voorspelling van de: If the full PV forecast for the relevant solar day is below this value, the EMS can switch to Battery Save per price category. During the solar day HomeFlux uses today; once night planning is active the same logic uses tomorrow. Choose under Energy contract which categories should use this.
exact.Waarschuwen als Battery Balance verder u: Warn if Battery Balance keeps drifting apart
exact.Netexport verbieden — PV automatisch ter: Prevent grid export — automatically limit PV
exact.PV-begrenzing / exportbuffer vanaf batte: PV limiting / export buffer from battery SoC (%)
exact.EMS-uitvoer actief — batterijcommando's: EMS output active — actually publish battery commands
exact.Batterij-override automatisch hervatten: Automatically resume battery override on the next tariff trend
exact.zonder geldige netmeting wordt niet gere: without a valid grid measurement, control is disabled. Missing PV/forecast data degrades the strategy; a missing battery SoC only excludes that battery. EMS output remains locked until the charge test for the current battery configuration and sign direction has been confirmed as passed.
exact.Bepaalt welk deel van de gemeten netafwi: Determines how much of the measured grid deviation is corrected per control step: Quiet 65%, Normal 85%, Exact 100%. No profile deliberately overshoots the measured deviation. PV delta does not increase this gain.
exact.PV-delta voor live netreactie (W): PV delta for live grid response (W)
exact.De echte batterij-uitvoer verandert maxi: Actual battery output changes at most once per this interval. Live status shows a new preview every 2 seconds calculated from the last actual output.
exact.Bij lage PV-voorspelling batterij sparen: Save battery on low PV forecast during Fixed tariff
exact.Bij Batterij sparen toch ontladen tot fo: During Battery Save, still discharge down to forecast target SoC
exact.Als deze optie aan staat, mag HomeFlux t: When enabled, HomeFlux may use only the reserve above the calculated forecast target during Battery Save. Normal discharge stops at the forecast target. Planned grid charging and Peak Guard keep their priority.
exact.Batterij ook tijdens normale prijsuren g: Also use battery during normal price hours
exact.Batterij sparen bij lage PV-voorspelling: Battery Save on low PV forecast
exact.Ontladen tot forecast-doel tijdens Batte: Discharge to forecast target during Battery Save
exact.Standaard laadstroom op geselecteerd tar: Standard charge current on selected tariff (A)
exact.Laaddoel gegarandeerd proberen te behale: Try to guarantee the charge target
Status and charging current are received together. EV SoC deliberately uses a separate Flow card.
exact.EV standaard laden in het ingestelde vas: Charge EV normally in the configured fixed charging window
exact.HVAC laten draaien als de thuisbatterij: Allow HVAC when the home battery is used again
exact.PV-boost pas boven batterij-SoC (%): PV boost only above battery SoC (%)
exact.Direct terug naar normaal bij netimport: Return directly to normal above grid import (W)
exact.Welke HVAC-opdrachten mag HomeFlux geven: Which HVAC commands may HomeFlux send?
exact.In simulatie zie je de berekende waarde,: In simulation you see the calculated value, while the actual output remains 0 W.
exact.HomeFlux EMS is gratis te gebruiken. Vin: HomeFlux EMS is free to use. Do you find the app useful and want to support further development?
exact.Ondersteunen is volledig vrijwillig en h: Supporting is completely optional and has no impact on features or updates.
exact.Absolute ondergrens. Peak Guard mag tot: Absolute lower limit. Peak Guard may use the battery down to this limit, never below it.
exact.Standaard publiceert HomeFlux laden als: By default HomeFlux publishes charging as a negative value and discharging as a positive value. Enable this when your battery or Flow expects the opposite convention. The internal EMS calculation does not change; only the published values are inverted. A new charge test is required after changing this.
exact.Rondt elk werkelijk batterijsetpoint con: Rounds every actual battery setpoint conservatively toward the lower absolute step. For example 178 W → 100 W and -178 W → -100 W, so rounding can never command more power than calculated. Choose 100 W for systems such as LUNA that accept 100, 200, 300 … W steps. The next control cycle continues correcting from the real grid measurement.
exact.De waarschuwing kijkt naar de trend: als: The warning watches the trend: if the SoC spread clearly grows during active balancing and keeps increasing, first verify that Battery 1 SoC really belongs to Battery 1 Command, and so on.
exact.Peak Guard staat boven alle modi. Tijden: Peak Guard has priority over every mode. During charging or self-consumption, charging power is reduced first; if necessary, discharging is allowed to keep grid import below the limit.
exact.Boven de ingestelde batterij-SoC mag Hom: Above the configured battery SoC, HomeFlux may deliberately keep a small continuous export. For example, 50 W means a target around -50 W. Below the SoC threshold this export buffer is fully disabled and the home battery receives the PV surplus.
exact.Standaard 95%. Onder deze gemiddelde bat: Default 95%. Below this average battery SoC, PV stays at 100% and battery control does not use a deliberate export buffer. Without a valid battery SoC, PV is not limited and no export target is maintained.
exact.Eigen minimum verzendtijd voor de Flow-k: Separate minimum send interval for the Flow card “PV power limit is updated”. This is independent of the battery timer. For example: battery every 5 s, PV only every 30 s. No stale PV setpoint is queued while waiting; as soon as the timer is available HomeFlux recalculates using the latest measurements.
exact.Flow-kaart “PV-vermogenslimiet is bijgew: Flow card “PV power limit is updated”:
exact.. Gebruik de tag “PV-limiet (%)” om het: . Use the “PV limit (%)” tag to control maximum inverter/PV power. 100% means unrestricted. The card always respects the configured
exact.. PV-begrenzing én de bewuste exportbuff: . PV limiting and the deliberate export buffer are only allowed from the configured average battery SoC. Above that threshold, when export already exists, HomeFlux lets battery control preserve the small configured export buffer, predicts the grid result after the new battery command, and limits only the remaining surplus. This prevents battery charging and PV curtailment from correcting the same export twice. If even 10% PV output is still too much, additional export can remain technically unavoidable.
exact.Voer eerst de laadtest uit en bevestig d: Run the charge test first and confirm that all batteries are actually charging.
exact.De test publiceert gedurende 10 seconden: The test publishes a 100 W charging command to every configured battery for 10 seconds and then automatically returns all commands to 0 W. Verify physically or in the battery app that all batteries are charging. HomeFlux cannot reliably infer this from the setpoint itself.
exact.Standaard aan. Een handmatige EMS-modus: Enabled by default. A manual EMS mode (for example manual charging) remains active until the next real Cheap/Normal/Expensive transition and then returns to Automatic.
exact.Normaal stuurt de EMS op het tijdgewogen: Normally the EMS controls from the time-weighted average of the last 5 seconds of grid measurements. If PV power has changed by at least this value since the previous control moment, that cycle uses the latest live grid value. The PV delta is never added as extra power and does not increase control gain. 0 disables this function.
exact.Activeer dit voor batterijen die bepaald: Enable this for batteries whose charge schedules cannot accept certain time periods. During this window HomeFlux stops new battery calculations and publishes no new battery setpoint; the last valid setpoint is retained.
exact.Mag over middernacht lopen. Bij 23:59 →: May span midnight. With 23:59 → 00:00 exactly that final minute is blocked, and from 00:00 HomeFlux recalculates using the latest measurements.
exact.Geldt op het totale EMS-setpoint, niet p: Applies to the total EMS setpoint, not per battery. Outside the zero band, a real correction may always be sent at the next allowed control moment.
exact.Onder deze grens regelt HomeFlux opnieuw: Below this limit HomeFlux controls again. When correction is needed, the battery setpoint targets the midpoint between the lower and upper limits.
exact.Boven deze grens regelt HomeFlux opnieuw: Above this limit HomeFlux controls again. Example: 5–25 W gives a control target of 15 W, leaving margin on both sides.
exact.BELANGRIJK — minimum verzendtijd en Flow: IMPORTANT — minimum send interval and Flows:
exact.De Flow-trigger “Batterijcommando's zijn: The “Battery commands are updated” Flow trigger and active split-command cards respect the configured minimum time between battery commands. Split command also applies the separate minimum time of the active charge or discharge mode.
exact.Gebruik voor een normale batterij de gew: Use only this card when a Flow actually controls the battery. “New battery setpoint calculated” is a preview and may change multiple times within the minimum interval, so it must not directly switch the battery or send a setpoint.
exact.Bij voldoende PV-voorspelling blijft de: With sufficient PV forecast, the battery remains available for self-consumption and surplus charging. If there is a shortfall, the EMS can charge gently toward the calculated target during this window.
exact.Definieer eerst je contracttarieven één: Define your contract tariffs once, for example Super Off-Peak, Off-Peak and Peak. Per tariff, choose whether a low daily forecast should save the battery and whether HomeFlux may still use reserve above the forecast target SoC.
exact.Koppel daarna een tarief aan tijdsblokke: Then assign a tariff to time blocks and days. For example, 07:00–11:00 can be Peak on Mon–Fri and Off-Peak on weekends. A block that crosses midnight, such as 22:00–01:00, belongs to the selected start day.
exact.Dynamische contracten gebruiken uitsluit: Dynamic contracts use only current energy prices from Homey Energy. HomeFlux does not use fictional test prices as a fallback.
exact.Voor grotere batterijen: tijdens Normaal: For larger batteries: during Normal price periods, grid import is also avoided down to Minimum SoC. Off means saving the battery for the most expensive periods and PV capture.
exact.Kies per dynamische prijscategorie of ee: Choose per dynamic price category whether a low daily forecast should save the battery. The cheapest and most expensive hours/quarter-hours are classified automatically; everything in between is Normal.
exact.Kies per prijscategorie of de batterijre: Choose per price category whether battery reserve above the calculated forecast target SoC may still be used. Normal discharge stops at the forecast target.
exact.zonder bruikbare Homey-prijzen wordt nie: without usable Homey prices, no grid charging and no price-driven discharging take place. PV surplus capture and Peak Guard remain active.
exact.Uit = geen EV-inputs verwacht en geen EV: Off means no EV inputs are expected and no EV outputs are published.
exact.Uit voor laders zoals Smappee wanneer ge: Turn this off for chargers such as Smappee when vehicle SoC is unavailable. EV SoC requests then stop completely.
exact.Alleen in Slim. Indien nodig mag HomeFlu: Smart mode only. If needed, HomeFlux may also charge outside the selected tariffs. Peak Guard remains absolute.
exact.Bepaalt wie het beschikbare PV-overschot: Determines who receives the available PV surplus first.
exact.Wanneer EV en thuisbatterij tegelijk wil: When the EV and home battery both want to charge from the grid, this determines how the available room below Peak Guard is allocated.
exact.Flow status: “Stel EV 1-status in” · Flo: Flow status: “Set EV status” · Flow SoC: “Set EV SoC” · request: “EV 1 SoC is needed”.
exact.Het laadvenster zelf wordt ingesteld ond: The charging window itself is configured under Energy contract → Fixed tariff.
exact.Wijzig “EV standaard laden” per tarief o: Change “EV standard charging” per tariff under Energy contract → Tariffs. This list follows those settings automatically.
exact.De categorieën komen uit hetzelfde dynam: The categories come from the same dynamic Homey Energy contract.
Emergency charge ignores this selection. SoC target charges directly to the configured target. Smart uses PV and the tariffs selected above.
exact.Uit = HomeFlux verwacht geen HVAC-data e: Off means HomeFlux expects no HVAC data and shows no HVAC block in Live status. Energy boost only starts above the configured battery SoC.
800 means intervene around -800 W grid export.
exact.200 = terugregelen zodra de export richt: 200 means reduce the boost when export approaches -200 W or less.
exact.Ook wanneer EV-netladen start of Peak Gu: The extra HVAC boost is also removed immediately when EV grid charging starts or Peak Guard becomes active.
exact.Zodra HVAC actief is, verwacht HomeFlux: Once HVAC is active, HomeFlux expects the values below through Flow actions. This immediately shows which connection is still missing.
exact.De ventilatoruitgang gebruikt de ingeste: The fan output uses the configured minimum, maximum and step values. For Mitsubishi this can for example be 100 / 500 / 100.
exact.Setpointregeling gebeurt in stappen van: Setpoint control moves in 0.5 °C steps per control interval. Cooling lowers the setpoint; heating raises it. Configured comfort limits are never exceeded. When surplus disappears, the setpoint gradually returns, except during Peak Guard, large grid import, or the start of EV grid charging: then the boost is removed immediately.
exact.ruimtetemperatuur, buitentemperatuur, mo: room temperature, outdoor temperature, mode, setpoint and fan speed each have their own Flow action. The four outputs are published only when the corresponding permission above is enabled.
exact.Vooruitblik op forecast-netladen. Zodra: Preview of forecast-based grid charging. Once current PV power remains below 5 W for 10 minutes, HomeFlux considers solar production finished and calculates the night plan using tomorrow’s PV forecast. After midnight, that same forecast is used as today. If no PV power data arrives to determine the end, HomeFlux creates the night plan at 20:00. The target is never lower than Safety SoC. The Flow trigger “Charge plan is updated” provides a text tag that can be written to a text variable with the standard Logic card.
exact.Deze tab stuurt zelf niets aan en voegt: This tab does not control anything by itself and adds no polling of battery, grid, PV or forecast. The calculation runs only when you open Planning or refresh it manually. Actual battery setpoints remain determined by the normal EMS control cycle.
exact.Deze kaart wordt alleen getoond wanneer: This card is shown only when Homey Energy is selected as the dynamic price source. The conditions “during the cheapest hours”, “during the most expensive hours” and “in the cheapest consecutive block” are also available as HomeFlux EMS Flow conditions. With quarter-hour prices, 3 hours automatically means 12 quarter-hours.
exact.Voor echte batterijsturing via Flow:: For actual battery control via Flow:
exact.. Alleen deze trigger wordt gepubliceerd: . Only this trigger is published while respecting the configured minimum time between battery commands. The card
exact.is alleen een voorcalculatie en kan snel: is only a preview and may change faster.
exact.Standaard tekenconventie: positief = ont: Default sign convention: positive = discharge, negative = charge. With “Invert charge/discharge values”, all published battery setpoints and Flow tags are inverted. Use the global Flow tags “HomeFlux EMS - Battery X Command (W)” together with the trigger “Battery commands are updated” for actual battery control.
exact.Alle drie de forecastwaarden blijven zic: All three forecast values remain visible. The green highlighted card is the value HomeFlux is actually using now for the forecast target, Battery Save and night planning.
exact.Nachtplanning is actief. Forecast-doel e: Night planning is active. The forecast target and low-PV decisions now use tomorrow’s PV forecast. Today and remaining today are shown for information only.
exact.De zonnedag is actief. HomeFlux gebruikt: The solar day is active. HomeFlux uses today’s highest/full-day PV forecast for decisions; remaining today is informational only and therefore does not lower the target as the day progresses.
exact.De volledige dagvoorspelling van vandaag: Today’s full-day forecast is missing. HomeFlux therefore temporarily uses today’s remaining forecast as the decision basis.
exact.Er is geen bruikbare forecast voor de re: There is no usable forecast for the relevant solar day. Safety SoC remains the basis.
exact.Minimum en maximum vormen de harde batte: Minimum and maximum are the hard battery limits. Safety SoC and the save threshold determine how much reserve HomeFlux keeps during normal operation.
exact.Totale limieten gelden voor de volledige: Total limits apply to the complete battery group; per-battery limits constrain each individual battery.
exact.Deze instellingen bepalen hoe het bereke: These settings determine how the calculated battery power is ultimately published to your Flow or battery.
exact.Bepaalt hoe vaak een werkelijk batterijc: Determines how often an actual battery command may change and which small setpoint changes may be ignored.
exact.Voor batterijen die bepaalde periodes ni: For batteries that cannot include certain periods in their internal charge or discharge schedule. During this window the last valid setpoint is retained.
exact.Onder- en bovengrens horen samen. Zodra: The lower and upper bounds belong together. When HomeFlux moves outside this band, it controls back toward the midpoint of both values.
exact.De exportbuffer en batterij-SoC-drempel: The export buffer and battery SoC threshold determine when PV limiting may start. The send interval determines how often the PV output may actually change.
exact.Minimum en maximum vormen de laadstroomg: Minimum and maximum define the charge-current limits. The standard charge current is used when Smart charging is allowed to charge through a selected tariff.
exact.Deze twee grenzen bepalen wanneer HomeFl: These two thresholds determine when HomeFlux may activate cooling or heating respectively.
exact.HomeFlux verlaagt het setpoint in stappe: HomeFlux lowers the setpoint in 0.5 °C steps while always staying within these comfort limits.
exact.HomeFlux verhoogt het setpoint in stappe: HomeFlux raises the setpoint in 0.5 °C steps while always staying within these comfort limits.
exact.De boost start pas boven de ingestelde b: The boost only starts above the configured battery SoC. Start and stop margins belong together; with large grid import, EV grid charging or Peak Guard, the extra boost is removed immediately.
exact.Minimum en maximum bepalen het bereik; s: Minimum and maximum define the range; step size defines the valid intermediate values.
exact.De energiebehoefte stuurt de gewone dag-: Energy need drives normal day and night planning. Minimum reserve for the next daytime peak is only a protection layer during the solar day and only in the selected months. Remaining PV always has priority; only the shortfall that PV can no longer provide is protected or topped up cheaply.
exact.Voorwaartse planningsbehoefte. Overdag:: Forward planning need. During the day: need minus today’s remaining PV. After PV ends: need minus tomorrow’s PV. Current battery SoC already contains energy that was actually stored earlier today.
exact.Gewenste bruikbare reserve boven Minimum: Desired usable daytime reserve above Minimum SoC for the next peak period. Active only during the solar day and in selected months. HomeFlux deducts today’s remaining PV first; only the shortfall after PV is protected or may be topped up during a cheap daytime period.
exact.Dezelfde reserve als percentage van de t: The same reserve as a percentage of total battery capacity. Changing one field automatically updates the other. By default this reserve applies during the day; the option below can also apply it in night planning.
exact.HomeFlux gebruikt twee forecastrollen te: HomeFlux uses two forecast roles at the same time: the full-day forecast for day strategy/Battery Save, and the remaining forecast for energy planning from now. After PV ends, both use tomorrow’s forecast.
exact.Energieplanning en dagreserve met PV-voo: Energy planning and daytime reserve with PV priority
exact.Minimumreserve voor volgende dag piek (k: Minimum reserve for next daytime peak (kWh)
exact.Minimumreserve voor volgende dag piek (%: Minimum reserve for next daytime peak (% capacity)
exact.Meteorologische seizoenen: winter dec–fe: Meteorological seasons: winter Dec–Feb, spring Mar–May, summer Jun–Aug, autumn Sep–Nov. Summer is off by default, so HomeFlux relies fully on normal night/energy planning then.
exact.Minimumreserve voor volgende dag piek: Minimum reserve for next daytime peak
exact.De Flow-kaart Stel HVAC automatische stu: The Flow card Set HVAC automatic control can also enable or disable automatic control from your own Flows. This adds no extra polling.
exact.De ruimtetemperatuur bepaalt voortaan de: Room temperature now selects the mode. Within the activation margin PV surplus does nothing. Below the heating threshold Heat starts; above the cooling threshold Cool starts.
exact.Comfort: verwarmen mikt op de onderkant: Comfort: heating targets the lower edge and cooling the upper edge of the comfort zone. Maximize PV uses the full comfort zone as a thermal buffer.
exact.Buitentemperatuur kiest niet langer Heat: Outdoor temperature no longer selects Heat/Cool. It only determines fan speed. With Normal, about a 5 °C temperature difference on a 5-step scale means the highest setting.
exact.De automatische HVAC-sessie start alleen: The automatic HVAC session starts only with sufficient PV surplus and outside the configured activation margin. Peak Guard, high grid import or EV grid charging can end the extra HVAC control immediately.
exact.Ook wanneer EV-netladen start of Peak Gu: The extra HVAC control also stops immediately when EV grid charging starts or Peak Guard becomes active.
exact.EV’s werken onafhankelijk en staan niet: EVs operate independently and are not part of the thermal priority list. HomeFlux starts at most one new EV per normal EMS cycle.
exact.De naam wordt in tabs en Live status get: The name is shown in tabs and Live status. EV 1 always remains visible for Flow verification.
exact.Uit = geen inputs verwacht en de EV-uitg: Off = no inputs are expected and the EV outputs are safely stopped.
exact.Uit wanneer geen voertuig-SoC beschikbaa: Disable when no vehicle SoC is available. SoC requests for this EV then stop completely.
exact.Minimum stoptijd vóór EV-herstart (s): Minimum stop time before EV restart (s)
exact.Na iedere door HomeFlux gestuurde STOP b: After every STOP sent by HomeFlux, a mode-controlled EV remains stopped for at least this time. Peak Guard stops immediately. 0 = off.
exact.Alleen in Slim en met SoC. Peak Guard bl: Only in Smart mode and with SoC. Peak Guard remains absolute.
exact.Alleen bij modus-sturing en werkelijke E: Only with mode control and actual EV charging current. The margin can never create export by itself.
exact.Wijzig de laadkeuzes per tarief onder En: Change the charging choices per tariff under Energy contract.
exact.Vuurt alleen de gekozen EV 1-uitgang één: Fires only the selected EV 1 output once. Connected Flows may control the actual charger.
exact.Bij meerdere HVAC’s krijgt ieder toestel: With multiple HVAC devices, each device gets its own settings and numbered Flow cards. The priority list only determines the start order.
exact.Verder draaien op thuisbatterij toestaan: Allow continued operation on the home battery
exact.HVAC uitschakelen onder batterij-SoC (%): Switch HVAC off below battery SoC (%)
exact.Alleen van toepassing wanneer verder dra: Only applies when continued operation on the home battery is allowed.
exact.Onder de verwarmingsgrens start Heat; bo: Below the heating threshold Heat starts; above the cooling threshold Cool starts. Within the activation margin PV does nothing.
exact.Comfort eerst mikt op de dichtstbijzijnd: Comfort first targets the nearest comfort limit. Minimize PV surplus uses the full comfort zone as a thermal buffer.
exact.PV-sturing pas boven batterij-SoC (%): PV control only above battery SoC (%)
exact.Welke HVAC 1-opdrachten mag HomeFlux gev: Which HVAC 1 commands may HomeFlux send?
exact.HomeFlux publiceert alleen een eenvoudig: HomeFlux publishes only a simple yes/no output.
exact.Boiler laden vanaf batterij-SoC (%): Start water heater from battery SoC (%)
exact.Boiler stoppen onder batterij-SoC (%): Stop water heater below battery SoC (%)
exact.HomeFlux start pas wanneer minstens dit: HomeFlux starts only when at least this actual remaining surplus is available.
exact.De looptijd is cumulatief. Onderbrekinge: Runtime is cumulative. Interruptions caused by clouds or SoC do not erase progress.
exact.Boiler wordt opnieuw koud om: Water heater becomes cold again at
exact.Standaard 07:00. Een volledige opwarmcyc: Default 07:00. A completed heating cycle remains warm until this daily reset time, so daytime PV heating is not unnecessarily restarted during the night.
exact.Na zoveel dagen zonder volledige cyclus: Use tariff fallback after this many days without a full cycle
exact.0 = nooit. De toegestane tarieven worden: 0 = never. Allowed tariffs are selected under Energy contract.
exact.Boiler tariefladen vanaf batterij-SoC (%: Start tariff heating from battery SoC (%)
exact.Standaard 40%. Tijdens een geselecteerd: Default 40%. During an allowed tariff, the battery first reaches this reserve before the water heater may start.
exact.Boiler tariefladen stoppen op batterij-S: Stop tariff heating at battery SoC (%)
exact.Standaard 30%. Na de start op 40% mag de: Default 30%. After starting at 40%, the water heater may continue until this lower threshold. This provides hysteresis and avoids on/off cycling around the same SoC.
exact.HomeFlux probeert één volledige opwarmcy: HomeFlux first attempts one complete heating cycle per day using PV. Only after the configured number of days without a completed cycle may the water heater continue during selected tariffs.
exact.Boiler-fallback toestaan in het vaste la: Allow water-heater fallback in the fixed charging window
exact.Alleen na het ingestelde aantal dagen zo: Only after the configured number of days without a complete heating cycle.
exact.Standaard 5 minuten. Dit bepaalt alleen: Default 5 minutes. This only determines when an additional water heater/HVAC may start; safety stops remain immediate.
exact.EV’s staan bewust niet in deze lijst. Ze: EVs are deliberately excluded from this list. They use their own PV/tariff logic. The actual P1 position after EV charging automatically determines what remains.
exact.Alleen de ingeschakelde boiler en HVAC’s: Only enabled water-heater and HVAC devices appear. At each priority moment, at most one new thermal device is released. A running device is not switched off because a higher-priority device becomes available later.
exact.Schakel de boiler of minstens één HVAC i: Enable the water heater or at least one HVAC to define the start order.
exact.0 = boilerfunctionaliteit niet gebruiken: 0 = do not use water-heater functionality. HomeFlux currently supports at most one water heater.
exact.Kies hierboven 1 om de boilerregeling en: Choose 1 above to configure water-heater control and tariff fallback.
exact.Kies hierboven 1–4 wanneer HomeFlux EV-l: Choose 1–4 above when HomeFlux should manage EV chargers.
exact.Kies hierboven 1–4 wanneer HomeFlux HVAC: Choose 1–4 above when HomeFlux should manage HVAC devices.
exact.Minimum-SoC voor dagplanning in geselect: Minimum SoC for day planning in selected months (%)
exact.Apart minimum-SoC gebruiken in niet-gese: Use a separate minimum SoC in non-selected months (sunny months)
exact.Minimum-SoC voor dagplanning in zonnemaa: Minimum SoC for day planning in sunny months (%)
exact.Minimum-SoC's ook gebruiken voor nachtpl: Also use minimum SoCs for night planning
exact.Actief minimum-SoC voor volgende piek: Active minimum SoC for next peak
exact.Energieplanning en minimumreserve met PV: Energy planning and minimum reserve with PV priority
exact.De energiebehoefte stuurt de gewone dag-: Expected energy demand drives normal day and night planning. Selected months use the kWh reserve; non-selected sunny months can use a separate minimum SoC. During the day this remains PV-first. The option below can also apply the same minimum values to night planning for the next peak.
exact.Kies per kalendermaand wanneer de kWh-re: Choose the calendar months in which the kWh reserve is active. Non-selected months are treated as sunny months when the separate minimum SoC below is enabled.
exact.Actief in maanden die hierboven niet zij: Active in months that are not selected above. During the day remaining PV gets full priority first. The night option below can also use the same minimum in night planning for the next peak.
exact.Dit is een apart minimum voor de niet-ge: This is a separate minimum for non-selected months. During the day HomeFlux first calculates how much of this minimum can still be supplied by remaining PV. In night planning, when the extra option is enabled, expected energy demand and PV before the next peak are both taken into account.
exact.Minimumwaarden ook toepassen in nachtpla: Also apply minimum values in night planning
exact.Actieve minimumreserve voor volgende pie: Active minimum reserve for next peak
exact.Uit = huidig gedrag: de minimumreserve/m: Off = current behaviour: the minimum reserve/minimum SoC applies only during daytime planning. On = night planning also targets the minimum value for the next peak. HomeFlux adds expected energy demand and the requested reserve, then subtracts the PV forecast before the peak once; only the remaining shortfall is planned in allowed cheap charging windows.
exact.Minimum-SoC gebruiken in niet-geselectee: Use minimum SoC in non-selected months (sunny months)
exact.Dagminimum-doel na resterende PV: Daytime minimum target after remaining PV
exact.Test de automatische planningslogica met: Test the automatic planning logic with values of your choice. The simulation publishes no battery, PV, EV, HVAC or water-heater commands, saves no results and changes no EMS state. Leaving this tab clears only the result; the entered test fields remain while this settings page stays open.
exact.Dit opgegeven doel wordt voor de simulat: This entered target is used as the final planning target for the simulation. It is still limited by Minimum SoC, Safety SoC and Maximum SoC.
exact.Tijdens de dag is dit de resterende PV v: During the day this is today’s remaining PV. In the night before PV starts it is today’s forecast; after PV ends it is tomorrow’s forecast.
exact.Vanaf 5 W wordt de dagplanning gesimulee: From 5 W onward, day planning is simulated. Below 5 W, night planning is used; the selected time determines whether this is before PV starts or after PV ends.
exact.Het uur wordt toegepast op de huidige lo: The time is applied to the current local date and uses the Homey time zone for tariffs, charging windows and planning phase.
exact.Kies per kalendermaand wanneer deze dagr: Choose per calendar month when this daytime reserve may be active. On upgrade, your existing season choices are automatically translated to the same months.
exact.Optionele uitweg wanneer de werkelijke d: Optional escape when the actual day performs clearly better than the PV forecast. This only affects low-PV Battery Save; the forecast itself and Peak Guard do not change.
exact.Schakel lage-PV-dag naar zonnedag bij ho: Switch low-PV day to sunny day at high battery SoC
exact.Alleen tijdens de actieve dagplanning (n: Only during active day planning (after PV production has been observed). Once the average SoC stays continuously at or above the selected threshold for the configured time, HomeFlux treats the current day as a sunny day for low-PV logic. If SoC drops before the timer completes, the timer starts again. After switching, sunny-day status remains active for the rest of the current day-planning phase.
exact.Minimum stoptijd na Peak Guard (s): Minimum stop time after Peak Guard (s)
exact.Standaard 60 s. Na iedere door HomeFlux: Default 60 s. After any STOP sent by HomeFlux, a charge-mode controlled EV remains stopped for at least this time before charging may restart. Peak Guard still stops immediately. 0 = off.
exact.Bij laadmodus-sturing en EV eerst houdt: With charge-mode control and EV first, HomeFlux keeps this amount of export once measured EV charge current is above 0 A. This lets the EV continue to detect available PV headroom. At 0 A, normal control remains active.
exact.HomeFlux start alleen een nieuwe HVAC-re: HomeFlux only starts new HVAC control when sufficient PV surplus is available. Battery continuation can only extend a session that was already started by PV.
exact.Comfort eerst volgt de ingestelde verwar: Comfort first follows the configured heating or cooling temperature. Minimize PV surplus may preheat or precool further within the configured deviation.
exact.Bij PV-overschot minimaliseren mag HomeF: When minimizing PV surplus, HomeFlux may heat up to this amount above the heating temperature and cool up to this amount below the cooling temperature. The activation temperatures remain the only thresholds that decide whether Heat or Cool starts.
exact.EV stoppen na 60 s netafname (W): Stop EV after 60 s grid import (W)
exact.split-command Flow-kaarten voor laadmodu: split-command Flow cards for charge mode, discharge mode, charge power and discharge power
exact.Vuurt alleen de gekozen EV-uitgangskaart: Fires only the selected EV output card once. EMS settings, timers and normal output state are not changed. Note: a connected Flow can still control your real charger.
exact.Vuurt alleen de gekozen HVAC-uitgangskaa: Fires only the selected HVAC output card once. The normal HVAC controller and its last published values are not changed. Note: connected Flows can control real HVAC devices.
exact.De snelle batterijregelkring blijft dire: The fast battery control loop remains responsive. Slow context such as EV, HVAC, water heater, tariffs and forecast is processed only on a lower shared cadence or when a necessary change occurs.
exact.De snelle regelkring berekent alleen het: The fast loop calculates only the required battery setpoint and changes the real battery output at most once per this interval.
exact.Standaard 60 s. EV, HVAC, boiler, tarief: Default 60 s. EV, HVAC, water-heater, tariff, forecast and status context runs only when that context changed, using this interval as the minimum between normal context calculations. Safety interventions may run immediately.
exact.Standaard 5 min. Relevante wijzigingen m: Default 5 min. Relevant changes mark the charge plan as outdated, but HomeFlux keeps the last valid plan and rebuilds at most one plan per this interval. The first plan, manual refresh and fixed decision moments may calculate immediately.
exact.De nacht- en dagplanning hebben elk hun: Night and day planning each have their own endpoint. This prevents HomeFlux from planning from the evening all the way through the following day.
exact.Stel dit bij voorkeur in op de start van: Preferably set this to the start of your first morning peak. After PV ends, HomeFlux uses the next day’s PV forecast and only plans allowed charging windows up to this morning target. Default 07:00.
exact.Zodra PV-productie de dagplanning active: Once PV production activates day planning, HomeFlux plans from the morning target only up to this configured daytime time. For example, use 17:00 if you want enough energy available for cooking or the evening period.
exact.Nachtplanning tot ingesteld ochtenddoel: Night planning up to configured morning target
exact.Dagplanning tot ingesteld dagdoel: Day planning up to configured daytime target
exact.Geen goedkoop laadvenster gevonden vóór: No cheap charging window found before the target time.
exact.Alle laadvensters vóór het doelmoment zi: All charging windows before the target time have already passed; no charging time remains.
exact.Totale limieten gelden voor de volledige: Total limits apply to the complete battery group; the shared per-battery limits are used while individual battery limits are disabled.
exact.Mijn batterijen hebben verschillende ver: My batteries have different power limits
exact.Schakel dit in wanneer niet alle batteri: Enable this when your batteries do not all have the same charge and discharge specifications. HomeFlux then uses a separate maximum charge power and maximum discharge power for each battery. Configure technical minimum power only through Split Command when a battery requires it.
exact.HomeFlux bewaart alleen compacte dagtota: HomeFlux stores only compact daily totals. The calculation uses the existing grid and PV measurements and the actually published battery power; no extra polling is added.
exact.Kosten van netenergie waarmee de batteri: Cost of grid energy used to charge the battery during this period. PV charging remains €0.
exact.Waarde van directe PV, PV uit de batteri: Value of direct PV, PV from the battery and the price difference of grid energy shifted to a later tariff.
exact.Bij een dynamisch contract gebruikt Home: With a dynamic contract, HomeFlux uses the current Homey Energy purchase price. A separate dynamic feed-in price is not available from the current price source, so HomeFlux does not invent additional profit.
exact.v0.4.9 — HomeFlux, jouw energie, anders: v0.4.9 — HomeFlux, your energy, managed differently
